text: Fixing verified audit bugs in-session (not spun off). Scope: (1) render_spec expand_slide default True->None; (2) bind flow connectors via begin/end_connect to node group shapes, then RESTORE computed anchor coords so qlmanage PNG is unchanged while PowerPoint re-derives from stCxn/endCxn (editable); (3) --page CLI flag on render+generate + shared render pipeline so generate honors 16:9/free and prints layout report; (4) release quality profile: promote scale/cramped/tiny-font warnings to errors so --strict fails on unreadable output; (5) docs sync page field. DEFER architecture-model restructure and prompt slimming (design decisions). Verified empirically: begin_connect snaps endpoint to group CONTENT bbox (narrower than card) so naive bind would shift every gallery PNG; restore-coords avoids that, stCxn retained. Side->cxn idx map {top:0,left:1,bottom:2,right:3} (counter-clockwise from top, python-pptx convention).
